component.name: MCRAWsome
component.summary: Develop MCRAW recordings and send them to DaVinci Resolve

description.p: MCRAWsome is an independent, open-source desktop application for RAW (MCRAW) and LOG recordings made with MotionCam Pro. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by MotionCam.

Browse recordings, preview a neutral image, manage clip details and trim ranges, and prepare virtual CinemaDNG media for DaVinci Resolve. Export CinemaDNG, scene-linear OpenEXR, or lossless trimmed and repaired MCRAW recordings.
GNOME Files integration adds Media Bin and Timeline actions for selected MCRAW recordings. You can disable the menu in Settings. File associations can be changed in your file manager.
Debian 13 package using system libraries, with RAW and LOG previews, CinemaDNG and OpenEXR exports, lossless MCRAW copies, and native Resolve handoff.
